gloss: director-general; secretary (head of a government agency)

definitions.gloss: director-general; head of a government agency
definitions.explanation: The official title of the head of certain government bodies, such as an agency ({庁|ちょう}) in Japan or a cabinet department in the United States.

examples.japanese: {長官|ちょうかん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{会見|かいけん}→会見：11447_kaiken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|ひら}いた→開く：01979_hiraku⟧。
examples.english: The director-general held a press conference.

examples.japanese: ⟦{気象庁|きしょうちょう}→気象庁：30107_kishouchou⟧{長官|ちょうかん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{注意|ちゅうい}→注意：01464_chuui⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{呼|よ}びかけた→呼びかける：06480_yobikakeru⟧。
examples.english: The head of the Japan Meteorological Agency urged caution.

examples.japanese: ⟦アメリカ→アメリカ：01769_amerika⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{国務|こくむ}{長官|ちょうかん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{来日|らいにち}→来日：13060_rainichi⟧し、{外務大臣|がいむだいじん}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{会談|かいだん}→会談：11542_kaidan⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The U.S. Secretary of State visited Japan and held talks with the Foreign Minister.

notes:
In Japan, the head of a {省|しょう} (ministry) is a ⟦{大臣|だいじん}→大臣：03417_daijin⟧, while the head of a {庁|ちょう} (agency) is usually a {長官|ちょうかん}. In news about the United States, {長官|ちょうかん} translates "Secretary" ({国務長官|こくむちょうかん}, Secretary of State).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {官房|かんぼう}{長官|ちょうかん}: Chief Cabinet Secretary
- {警察庁|けいさつちょう}{長官|ちょうかん}: Commissioner General of the National Police Agency
- {国務|こくむ}{長官|ちょうかん}: (U.S.) Secretary of State

WATCH OUT:
Homophone: ⟦{朝刊|ちょうかん}→朝刊：16382_choukan⟧ (morning newspaper).
